newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico grants 11 companies local telephone rights.
newsitem.headline: Mexico grants 11 companies local telephone rights.

text.p: The Mexican government granted 11 companies local telephone concessions as part of the opening of local service to private firms, Deputy Communications and Transport Minister Jaime Lozano said on Thursday.
A total of 23 companies applied for the concessions to compete with longtime local telephone monopoly Telefonos de Mexico.
"To date we have given 11 permits to public telephone service providers," Lozano said at a forum on local telephone competition.

Authorized Mexican companies include: Telecomunicaciones Publicas y Privadas, Aditel, Telefonica y Servicios Integrales, Radiocel de Mexico, World Center of Video Conference, Modetel, Logica Industrial and BBG Comunicaciones.
